response.sql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT c.zoneref, s.insurstat
  FROM scanconservation AS c
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref
), grouped AS (
  SELECT zoneref, insurstat, COUNT(*) AS conservation_count,
         CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched) AS fraction
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY zoneref, insurstat
)
SELECT zoneref, insurstat, conservation_count, fraction
FROM grouped
ORDER BY fraction DESC, (insurstat IS NULL) ASC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: “Unrounded” means return the full ratio as a SQLite floating-point value; SQLite does not provide arbitrary-precision division by default.
